verdict.rationale: WorkOS's RBAC docs say developers can configure roles, permissions and organization-scoped roles in the Dashboard or via API, and enforce access through session JWTs. That covers defining, enforcing and surfacing roles and permissions in tokens. The 2020 community remark that RBAC wasn't available yet predates the current docs and does not contradict them. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the JWT role/permission claim structure and enforcement helpers, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define roles and permissions and have them enforced and surfaced in session tokens for authorization checks

citations.quote: teams can also define custom roles at the organization or tenant level, assign permissions to those roles, and enforce access policies at scale
Configure roles, permissions, and organization-scoped roles directly in the WorkOS Dashboard or using the API
